children: Here are news, reports and events that may affect Turkish financial markets on Friday.
The lira was quoted at 50.7760-50.7875 against the U.S. dollar at 0430 GMT, after closing at 50.6750 on Thursday.
The BIST 100 index closed 0.82% higher at 10,743.11 points on Thursday.
GLOBAL MARKETS

Asian shares were set to end a bruising month on a steadier note as a holiday lull offered some respite from AI jitters, while the dollar reigned supreme, riding a wave of safe-haven demand and rate hike bets towards a third month of gains.
YUSUF KENAN BAGIR APPOINTED HEAD OF BDDK
Turkey appointed Yusuf Kenan Bagir as chairman of the banking watchdog BDDK, a presidential decision published in the Official Gazette showed on Friday.
TURKEY ON MSCI REQUIREMENTS

Turkey expects to complete work to meet MSCI's requirements by the end of December, ahead of the index provider's June 2027 deadline, Finance Minister Mehmet Simsek said on Thursday, as Ankara seeks to bring its capital markets in line with international standards after an investment funds crisis.
INVESTMENT CRISIS STEPS
Turkey needs to overhaul its financial regulators after an investment fund scandal that has sent a chill through the country's capital markets, five bankers and a former senior official said.
FINANCIAL STABILITY REPORT
The Central Bank publishes its financial stability report. (0730 GMT)
ECONOMIC CONFIDENCE INDEX
The Turkish Statistical Institute announces the economic confidence index for November. (0700 GMT)
BESIKTAS MATCH TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED

The Europa League match between Besiktas and Hapoel Beer-Sheva was suspended for 30 minutes on Thursday after clashes broke out in the stands, with video footage showing police confronting Besiktas supporters.
PRESIDENTIAL BUDGET
Vice President Cevdet Yilmaz will present the 2027 budget for the presidency to parliament's planning and budget committee.  (0800 GMT)
TURKEY-RUSSIA ECONOMIC COMMISSION
-Minister of Trade Omer Bolat takes part in a signing ceremony for a protocol of the Turkey-Russia Joint Economic Commission and the Turkey-Russia business forum in Istanbul. (0700 GMT)
HIGH-SPEED TRAIN LINE
Minister of Transport and Infrastructure Abdulkadir Uraloglu holds a press briefing in Bursa regarding the Osmaneli-Bursa high-speed rail line. (0700 GMT)
